summary.tldr: Replaces the process for reviewing federally appointed judges’ conduct and changes how removal recommendations are made.
what_it_does: Replaces the Canadian Judicial Council process for reviewing the conduct of federally appointed judges.
Creates a new process for allegations of misconduct that are not serious enough to justify removing a judge from office.
Changes how recommendations to remove a judge from office can be made to the Minister of Justice.
Applies the same new process to other people appointed under an Act of Parliament to hold office during good behaviour.
summary.background: The bill amends the Judges Act and replaces the process used by the Canadian Judicial Council to review the conduct of federally appointed judges.
